exercises.task: Write innerJoin(): match enrollments to students, keep matches only. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: Loop enrollments, find() the student, skip when there's no match.

exercises.task: Write leftJoin(): every student, NULL course when unmatched. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: map over students; find() the enrollment or use null.

exercises.task: Write checkFK(): find orphan enrollments pointing at no student. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: filter ids where no student matches.
